name: Design Patterns
summary: Overview of 22 classic software design patterns grouped by intent, with a catalog of patterns and a companion book.
description: Explains what design patterns are and why they are useful, then links the catalog of 22 classic patterns in three groups: creational (5), structural (7) and behavioral (10). The page also covers classification, history and criticism of patterns and points to the book Dive Into Design Patterns.
contains: catalog of 22 classic design patterns grouped by intent
sections: benefits of patterns, classification, history, criticism
companion book: Dive Into Design Patterns
